# Datarithm

> > Datarithm provides cloud-based perpetual inventory management and pharmacy automation software for independent pharmacies, featuring EDI integration, delivery optimization, and real-time analytics.

Datarithm helps independent pharmacies optimize cash flow, reduce COGS, and improve profitability through automated inventory management that integrates with pharmacy management systems (PMS). The platform includes perpetual inventory tracking, automated reordering, regulatory compliance tools, and delivery route optimization via partnerships like iApotheca's EconoRoute.

## Key Topics

- Perpetual Inventory
- Pharmacy Inventory Management
- EDI Integration
- PMS (Pharmacy Management Systems)
- Automated Reordering

- Cash Flow Optimization
